name: 망혼
silhouette: 머리 위로 솟은 헝클어진 머리카락, 하반신이 없는 흐릿한 꼬리 형태, 헐렁한 수의 실루동
visual_en: A small 2-head tall spirit with messy dark slate hair and glowing cyan eyes. The entity wears a tattered, off-white shroud made of heavy fabric, showing visible greyish frayed edges. Instead of legs, a wispy, translucent tail of dark teal smoke drifts downwards. The upper body is a pale cyan-grey, contrasting with the dark navy shadows of the tattered clothing. A bright cyan glow emanates from the eyes and small floating particles around the head, making it visible against dark dungeon floors.
pose_en: Floating erratically while swaying side to side in a rapid wave-like pattern.
vfx_en: A trail of bright cyan misty particles following the movement.
lore: 떼로 몰려온다(티로처럼 좌우로 흔들며 몰려오는 가장 빠른 떼 몹).
concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A blue-skinned humanoid character with dark hair, wearing a white cloak, featuring a large fish-like tail instead of lower legs.
